title: Always Trouble with Ice Oroks
description: Always Trouble with Ice Oroks — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Ex-Soldier Bubba

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 10 reprinted Kingdom Cooling Protest Leaflets, 10 reprinted Protest Permits, and 10 reprinted "Picket Signs" from all creatures in Lower Algor's Terror Dome and it's branches.

Quest Reward: 2000 Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Ex-Soldier Bubba

Repeatable: No.

Following Quest:

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 10 Reprinted Orok Picket Signs, Collect 10 Reprinted Protest Permits from the Ice Orok Protest Leaders, and Collect 10 Reprinted Kingdom Cooling Protest Leaflets from all Creatures in Lower Algor's Terror-Dome and Return to Ex-Soldier Bubba in Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp.

Offer:

The paper work still isn't ready, which is good because I need you to continue your work against the Ice Orok Protestors and their efforts to rally the good people of this Kingdom to their cause. They recently did a reprint of their literature so I want you to get out there and collect 10 Reprinted Orok Picket Signs, collect 10 Reprinted Protest Permits from the Ice Orok Protest Leaders, and collect 10 Reprinted Kingdom Cooling Protest Leaflets from all creatures in Lower Algor's Terror-Dome including the branches located off of Algor's Terror-Dome.

When you have all that you need return to me, Ex-Soldier Bubba, here in the Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp.

Turn-in:

Fantastic! That should buy us a couple more days to hold out against the Ice Orok Protestors while the Bureau of Aristocratic Bureaucracies does their job. Here is your reward and let me know if you are willing to do this task for me again.

Objectives:

  • Reprinted Orok ''Picket Signs'' ×10
  • Reprinted Protest Permit ×10
  • Reprinted Kingdom Cooling Leaflets ×10

Level range: 16–30
